### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues are recorded for the change to omit unset configuration values while preserving disabled recovery. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes #7278 by omitting unset values from SDK-generated pycti helper configuration, preventing numeric options from triggering `int(None)` errors while preserving disabled stream recovery. **Changes:** - Removes `None` values recursively from dictionaries after serialization. - Preserves the serializer-generated `"none"` keyword used to disable recovery. - Adds regression tests for unset optional fields and disabled recovery. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `connectors-sdk/​tests/​test_settings/​test_base_settings.py` | Adds regression tests for omitted values and preserved recovery settings. | | `connectors-sdk/​connectors_sdk/​settings/​base_settings.py` | Filters `None` values after serialization and documents why filtering happens afterward. |
Review effort: Balanced
